package.description: Universal structural analysis and design software

en-US.description: Universal structural analysis and design software
en-US.longDescription: MIDAS CIVIL NX serves as a universal structural analysis and design software. It caters to various structures and is not limited to bridges only, structures such as reinforced concrete bridges, pre-stressed concrete bridges, box-girder bridges, as well as underground structures, superstructures, and more could be simulated with MIDAS CIVIL NX.
en-US.name: MIDAS CIVIL NX

zh-CN.description: 通用结构分析与设计软件
zh-CN.longDescription: MIDAS CIVIL NX 是一款通用的结构分析与设计软件。它适用于多种结构，不仅限于桥梁，如钢筋混凝土桥梁、预应力混凝土桥梁、箱梁桥，以及地下结构、上部结构等，均可使用 MIDAS CIVIL NX 进行模拟。
